title: fix(app-shell): Studio Data rail's empty sentence points at the "+" above it
body:
Fixes #13127

Clause-②: no

## What changed

In a package with no objects, Studio's Data rail said "No objects yet — create one below to start". The rail draws nothing below that sentence: `StudioRail` renders its heading row (with the rail's only create control, the "+"), then the search box, then the list where the sentence sits. The sentence now names that "+", in the wording the Automations and Access rails already use for their own empty sentences (`engine.studio.auto.none`, `engine.studio.access.none`):

| locale | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| en | No objects yet — create one below to start | No objects yet — click “+” above to create one |
| zh | 还没有对象 — 在下方新建一个开始 | 还没有对象 — 点上方的「+」新建 |

Only the value of `engine.studio.data.noObjects` changes. No key is added or removed, and nothing on the package entry moves. Changeset: `.changeset/13127-data-rail-empty-copy.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Premise check against `main` at `961b69f`

1. `engine.studio.data.noObjects` renders inside the Data rail (`DataPillar` mounts `StudioRail` with `testId="studio-rail-data"`), in the list area under the heading row that carries the "+" (`addTestId="studio-rail-add"`). Confirmed: the "+" is above the sentence and nothing that creates is below it.
2. The sibling string that also says "below", `engine.studio.data.firstObjectHint` ("… Create one below; then design its fields …"), does not render in the rail. It renders in the content column's empty block, directly above that block's "New object" button (`data-testid="empty-state-new-object"`). Its pointer is right for where it renders, so it is unchanged (its zh value, "点击下方按钮创建一个", likewise).
3. The ten locale packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/` do not carry this key. The designer's own table in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` holds en and zh only (the `engine.*` carve-out its header describes), so those two rows are all that move; `check:i18n-drift`'s designer leg reports the zh row followed the en change.

No other key of that table is touched.

## Test

`StudioDesignSurface.emptyPackage.test.tsx` gains one case on the real `DataPillar` over an empty package: the rail's empty sentence is inside `studio-rail-data`, it names the "+" (en `“+”`, zh `「+」`), and the rail's `studio-rail-add` precedes the sentence in document order.

Ablation (one-off, not kept), run with the fix committed at `b316b28`: the en value was put back to the old text through `objectstack:scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob `73bdf93cdf49` → `42f7baac5071`). The new case went red, `expected 'No objects yet — create one below to …' to contain '“+”'`, and the file's other three cases stayed green (`Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`). Restore proven by blob == HEAD (`73bdf93cdf49`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Local gates, head `dfa0da6`

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the touched test file, the Automations/Access empty-state file, `studio-locale.i18n`, `zhPillarNames-11801`, `select-placeholder-literal-11252`, `block-config-i18n`, and the designer-parity and en-drift gate tests → `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 121 passed (121)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test config lists the touched test file) → exit 0, after the dependency closure build.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` (report), `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm changeset:check` → each exit 0.

Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## Selectors for a browser read

- The Data rail: `[data-testid="studio-rail-data"]`.
- Its "+": `[data-testid="studio-rail-data"] [data-testid="studio-rail-add"]`.
- The empty sentence: `[data-testid="studio-rail-data"] p` (the only paragraph in the rail while the package has no objects; it has no test id of its own).

## Acceptance notes

- Read-only packages (not changed here, and not made worse). When the package is read-only, the Data pillar passes no `onAdd` to `StudioRail`, so the rail draws no "+", yet the rail still renders `engine.studio.data.noObjects`; and the content column's block still shows `firstObjectHint` ("Create one below") while its button is hidden. The old text pointed below at nothing; the new text points above at nothing. objectui#12514 gave the Automations and Access rails the read-only posture "no rail pointer" (pinned in `StudioDesignSurface.emptyStates-12514.test.tsx`); the Data pillar did not get it. This is a source reading, not reproduced in a browser (it needs a non-writable package with no objects), and the render condition lives in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, outside this claim's file surface. Raised to the seat in the report; no carrier yet.
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` lists `engine.studio.data.readOnlyPackage` ("This package is read-only — switch to or create a writable package to add objects") as a confirmed dead-key candidate: no render site in `packages/app-shell/src`. Not touched: it is another key of the same table.
